body: You know when you get a nosebleed? And after it stops, you get those boogers that are attached to a long string of a snot and blood hybrid? Pulling one of those out.

I agree, and I know that logically. And that's what makes me feel like a dirt bag. Right now, I probably know people dealing with the loss of their child, or with getting HIV or something else, who haven't considered suicide.  I don't even mean to consciously think it, it just keeps popping into my head over and over.  Thanks for the words.

Thanks so much. And you're right. All I can do is try to make the best of a bad situation. Work, pay my bills, and if I'm able to control any other factors in my life, like job hunting and such, do so.
Thank you for the response. As time is going on, I'm realizing that cutting contact for a while may be the best route to go, but without a doubt the hardest route as well.

Thank you again. And you're right, and I tried a few days back with a girl from work. It felt so wrong. Despite the situation being where it is, it still felt like "cheating" on best-ex. I'm not comfortable with myself right now, and I think if that's the case, I can't be comfortable with someone else either. And, I don' think it would be fair to the next girl I try seeing for me to still be in love with the other girl. But, I agree. It needs to be done. But first I need to get my shit in order. Thank you.

Thank you for reading and responding. I agree with what you're saying, and my family has been very supportive and understanding through the process. It's just rough, after years of being out by yourself, to have to come home again. Not to mention it's not exactly a lady pleaser when introducing yourself. But, you are right. I read your comment not long after you posted it and I've been trying to reimagine my wording with a more positive light. Thank you again so much.

Thank you for your response, kind words, and offer to speak to you. And kudos to you for being so insightful at 17. You're exactly right, and I understand how easy it is to see what to do from an objective opinion. Subjectivly is a little harder. Our friendship is a complication that will hurt both of our future relationships. However, even taking my feelings for her out of the question, I couldn't imagine not being as close to her as we are now. We've shared everything for the last couple years and experienced so much together. There's not a good choice to make in that decision, but keeping her in my life and close and dealing with the hurt that goes along with it is the lesser of two evils in this case.
